result.topic_en: A note on summing $(\alpha-\ell)^2$ over the values of an integer-part (rounding) expression involving Gaussian integers, as $x+iy$ runs over all values lying in a triangle, with the individual terms $(1+i)(x+iy)$ rewritten.
result.transcription:
Math 13
$\left[\frac{(1+i)(x+iy)(A+i\mathfrak{B})}{a+ib}\right] = \alpha + i\ell$
summirt alle $-(\alpha \blacksquare \ell)^2$
Indem für $x+iy$ alle im $\Delta$ o liegenden Werthe gesetzt wer[?]
Die einzelnen $(1+i)(x+iy)$ sind [-unterdr[?]-]
$(1+i)(a+b) - (\xi + i\eta)$
$\left[(1+i)(A+i\mathfrak{B}) - \frac{(\xi+i\eta)(A+i\mathfrak{B})}{a+ib}\right]$
